scripts.build:pages: VITE_BASE_PATH=/BabylonSlate/ VITE_TEST_MODE=true pnpm --filter editor build && VITEPRESS_BASE=/BabylonSlate/docs/ pnpm --filter docs-site build && mkdir -p apps/editor/dist/docs && cp -a apps/docs/.vitepress/dist/. apps/editor/dist/docs/
scripts.test:editor-unit: vitest run --config vitest.workspace.ts --project jsdom apps/editor --shard=1/4 && vitest run --config vitest.workspace.ts --project jsdom apps/editor --shard=2/4 && vitest run --config vitest.workspace.ts --project jsdom apps/editor --shard=3/4 && vitest run --config vitest.workspace.ts --project jsdom apps/editor --shard=4/4
scripts.test:coverage: VITEST_COVERAGE=1 VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=4 vitest run --config vitest.workspace.ts --coverage && pnpm test:editor-unit
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm --filter docs-site build
